tasks.commitBody:
The event-create form's seven aria-only fields (season, series,
name, capacity, location, description, conductor) now carry
visible labels in the #239 idiom: a wrapping label with the
existing translated key rendered above each control, and the
control's aria-label deleted per the single-name rule — the same
shape the series form shipped in #239, so the two forms now read
identically. Labels are additive: placeholders, values, handlers,
testids and the #248 location datalist are unchanged.

Also folded in per the PO's note on the #242 verification: the
type select carried BOTH a visible label and a same-key aria-label
(the #205 F1 double-naming shape, predating #242) — the redundant
aria-label is gone, with a new null pin authored for it since no
existing test forced the removal.

Fieldset grouping stays deferred per the issue's own done-when.
No new copy: all seven keys existed, translated, in four locales —
consumed until now only by the attributes screen readers got while
sighted users guessed ('labeleid on tarvis').

Live gate (Joosep/Mihkel): open 'Uus sündmus' — every field now
says what it is, in the app language; nothing else moved.
